user.title: AI Task Fallback Chain
user.description: General settings. In the next steps you choose the AI Task entities (stages) in the order they should be tried.

data.name: Name
data.cooldown_quota: Pause after a quota / rate limit error (429)
data.daily_quota_until_reset: Pause a daily quota until it resets

data_description.timeout: If a stage does not answer within this time, the next stage is used.
data_description.retries: How often a stage is tried again right away when the model is overloaded or the server has a temporary problem (HTTP 500/502/503/504).
data_description.retry_delay: Waiting time before a retry. It grows with every retry (1×, 2×, …).
data_description.cooldown_error: How long a stage is skipped after a normal error. 0 = never skip.
data_description.cooldown_quota: How long a stage is skipped when its quota is used up. 0 = never skip.
data_description.daily_quota_until_reset: If the provider reports a quota per day (e.g. Gemini free tier), skip the stage until the quota resets at midnight Pacific time instead of the pause above.

stage.title: Stage {number}

error.duplicate_stage: This entity is already a stage of this chain.
error.chain_as_stage: A fallback chain cannot be a stage of a chain.
